import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 505;
    static long[][] comb = new long[MAX][MAX];
    static long[] f1 = new long[MAX];
    static long[] f2 = new long[MAX];
    static long[][] g1 = new long[MAX][MAX];
    static long[][] g2 = new long[MAX][MAX];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        long mod = sc.nextLong();

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            comb[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = (comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j]) % mod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
            f1[i] = 0;
            f2[i] = 0;
        }

        f1[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAX; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                f1[i] = (f1[i] + f1[j - 1] * f1[i - j] % mod * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
            f1[i] = (i + 1) * f1[i] % mod;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < MAX; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    sum = (sum + f1[k - 1] * f2[i - k] % mod + f2[k - 1] * f1[i - k]) % mod;
                }
                long c = comb[i - 1][j - 1];
                long val = (i + 1) * c % mod * sum % mod;
                f2[i] = (f2[i] + val) % mod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX; j++) {
                g1[i][j] = 0;
                g2[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        g1[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i < MAX; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                g1[i][j] = g1[i - 1][j];
                g2[i][j] = g2[i - 1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    g1[i][j] = (g1[i][j] + g1[i - k - 1][j - k] * f1[k] % mod * comb[j][k]) % mod;
                    g2[i][j] = (g2[i][j] + g1[i - k - 1][j - k] * f2[k] % mod * comb[j][k]) % mod;
                    g2[i][j] = (g2[i][j] + g2[i - k - 1][j - k] * f1[k] % mod * comb[j][k]) % mod;
                }
            }
            g1[i][i] = f1[i];
            g2[i][i] = f2[i];
        }

        System.out.println(g2[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
